records.decision: Move billing storage from Postgres to DynamoDB
records.concern: Kai reported that the backfill and the rollback path were never costed
records.outcome: A four-day estimate became 21 days and the migration was rolled back after two failed cutovers

records.decision: Replace the hosted identity provider with a self-hosted authentication service
records.concern: Nobody owned password reset, session revocation, or the on-call rotation for the new service
records.outcome: Launch slipped six weeks and a session-revocation gap kept 412 accounts signed in after a forced logout

records.decision: Ship the new checkout flow without a feature flag to save integration time
records.concern: Priya asked how the team would disable the flow if conversion dropped
records.outcome: A 9% conversion drop needed a 3-hour emergency redeploy because there was no kill switch

records.decision: Store EU customer analytics in the existing us-east-1 warehouse
records.concern: Data residency commitments in two signed contracts were never checked before the choice
records.outcome: A contractual review forced a regional warehouse rebuild that consumed 5 engineer-weeks

records.decision: Adopt a single vendor SDK for search, ranking, and analytics
records.concern: Ravi warned that the contract had no export path and no pricing ceiling
records.outcome: Renewal pricing rose 70% and the extraction project took two quarters

records.decision: Add live collaboration to the launch scope two weeks before the ship date
records.concern: The team agreed quickly in chat without asking who would cut existing scope
records.outcome: Launch shipped 18 days late and two committed integrations were dropped
